confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Glasgow and UK pricing, not checked against live menus or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by season, event calendar, and booking lead time. Accommodation anchors reflect typical July demand with taxes included. FX: the RBA daily table row for 2026-10-16 (0.6947) was read from search-result excerpts; the RBA overview page shows 0.6955 for 15 Oct, and the page metadata suggests the cached copy may be older, so the latest row should be confirmed on the RBA F11.1 file.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized UK cities with similar tourism profiles (Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh's lower-cost neighbourhoods). Glasgow is typically somewhat cheaper than Edinburgh for food, drink, and hotels. Drink anchors use the typical UK pub pint-to-cappuccino and cocktail-to-pint ratios as a cross-check.
